Craft Workbench v0.12.10

Double-click craft.exe. It opens the local Workbench in a standalone native app window without a command window.
The window uses Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome's app mode; install one of them if this computer has neither.
Advanced users may run craft-workbench.cmd or craft-workbench.ps1 from a terminal.
Settings live in %USERPROFILE%\.craft_data\settings.json and may relocate dataRoot.
This bundle includes the Node runtime and is intended for Windows x64.
